items.r3: The intent adds a copyright monitoring middlebox for the group of students to detect copyright violations from their wired connections, as described in the natural language policy.
The intent removes any bandwidth rate limits for the university endpoint, reflecting the statement that the University of Illinois does not have any rate limits.
The intent adds a traffic monitor middlebox for the dorms endpoint to monitor the amount of traffic per user, matching the description of University Housing monitoring traffic amounts.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that blocks the CounterStrike service, corresponding to the blocking of the CounterStrike server by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the AIM chat and file transfer services, as both are permitted by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the Battlenet service, since Battlenet is allowed by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows H323 video conferencing traffic, reflecting that H323 video conferencing is allowed by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that blocks the Everquest service, corresponding to the statement that Everquest is blocked by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the HTTP and HTTPS protocols, as both are allowed by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the IMAP and secure IMAP protocols, since IMAP and secure IMAP are allowed by the University firewall.

The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that blocks MSN video and MSN audio services, while allowing MSN chat, MSN application sharing, and file transfer services, matching the partial restrictions described.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the Net2Phone service, as Net2Phone is allowed by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the PC Telephone service, reflecting that PC-Telephone is allowed by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the POP3 and secure POP protocols, as both are allowed by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the SMTP protocol, since SMTP is allowed by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the Sony Playstation 2 service, because Sony Playstation 2 is allowed by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the SSH protocol, reflecting that SSH is allowed by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the Telnet protocol, since Telnet is allowed by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the Sorenson Videophone 200 service, as this service is allowed by the University firewall.
The intent adds a firewall middlebox for the university endpoint that allows the ftp and sftp protocols, matching the statement that FTP and SFTP servers are allowed by the University firewall.
The intent sets a download quota of 100 GB per week for the students group, reflecting the data limit of 100 GB per week for students.
The intent sets a download quota of 10 GB per day for the students group, active from 10:00 to 23:59, matching the 10 GB daily download limit between 10 AM and Midnight.
The intent adds a traffic monitor middlebox for the network endpoint to passively monitor throughput, corresponding to the system passively monitoring network throughput when traffic is light.

The intent sets a combined quota of 6 GB per day for any traffic on the dorms and wireless endpoints, active from 00:00 to 23:59, reflecting the 6 GB per 24-hour upload or download limit on ResNet and UIC wireless.
The intent blocks the file transfer service for the guests endpoint to prevent file sharing and downloading, as guests cannot run any file sharing/downloading program.
